title: OpenAI Unveils Half-Price AI Model to Target Enterprise Automation
summary: OpenAI unveils half-price AI model aimed at enterprise automation markets
detailed: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.1 Terra, a new artificial intelligence (AI) model that costs half as much as two of its other models and is practical for automating high-volume work such as reading invoices and entering their information into accounting software, the company said in a Monday (Oct.

GPT-6.1 Terra is “a significant step up” from GPT-5.6 Terra, while its standard application programming interface (API) prices are 50% lower than those of GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol, according to the release.
OpenAI made GPT-6.1 Terra available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex , and to developers through the OpenAI API, on Monday, per the release.
The company cut the price of GPT-5.6 Luna by 80%, cut the price of GPT-5.6 Terra by 20% and provided faster performance of GPT-5.6 Sol in the API while leaving its price unchanged.
